name: nix
description: Nix on these machines — Lix, the daemon's build parallelism and how to serialize concurrent builds, the shallow ~/repos/upstream/nixpkgs clone (fast fetch, rebase, worktrees), nixpkgs contribution rules (mandatory Assisted-by trailer, one PR per package), and packaging idioms for shell completions and man pages. Use whenever building, packaging or debugging anything with nix-build/nix/nixos-rebuild, editing nixpkgs or nixos-config, or preparing a nixpkgs PR.
